# Icon sources

The [bundled catalog](BrandIcons/README.md) contains 103 brand marks independent
of the watchlist. Stock and crypto symbols are matched exactly; SpaceX,
Anthropic and OpenAI are reserved marks with no speculative ticker mapping.

- `simple16`: [Simple Icons 16.0.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/16.0.0/icons), [CC0 license](SimpleIcons/LICENSE.md).
- `simple13`: [Simple Icons 13.0.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/13.0.0/icons), [CC0 license](SimpleIcons/LICENSE-13.md).
- `crypto`: [Cryptocurrency Icons 0.18.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cryptocurrency-icons/v/0.18.1), [CC0 license](CryptocurrencyIcons/LICENSE.md).
- `local`: Microsoft's four-square mark drawn from four colored rectangles.

Upstream SVG geometry is retained; the app applies contrast-aware display
colors. The XRP currency mark comes from the crypto collection rather than
the separate Ripple company mark. Source versions and SHA-256 hashes are
recorded in [the manifest](BrandIcons/catalog.json).

Brand names and marks belong to their respective owners. SF Symbols are
supplied by iOS. Gold's brick glyph and the Muyar app icon are drawn locally.
